name: quotient
description: Token cost quotes for Claude Code: see what an AI job will cost before it starts, choose a level, get the real cost after, and split big jobs into daily installments that respect your 5-hour and weekly usage limits.

threshold.title: Threshold / Soglia
threshold.description: From how many weighted tokens a job gets a quote first (100000 = often, 300000 = default, 1000000 = only huge jobs). / Da quanti token pesati un lavoro riceve prima un preventivo.

reserve_percent.title: Weekly reserve % / Riserva settimanale %
reserve_percent.description: Share of the weekly limit kept free for normal use: installments never plan into it. / Parte del limite settimanale tenuta libera per l'uso normale.

lang.title: Report language / Lingua del resoconto
lang.description: Language of the report and the status line. / Lingua del resoconto e della riga di stato.

after.title: After installments / Dopo le rate
after.description: What the PC does after a scheduled installment, if nobody is using it. / Cosa fa il PC dopo una rata, se nessuno lo usa.

wake.title: Wake the PC for installments / Svegliare il PC per le rate
wake.description: Scheduled installments may wake the PC from sleep or hibernation. Off: they run only when the PC is already on. / Le rate programmate possono svegliare il PC; se spento, partono solo con il PC gia' acceso.

share.title: Share anonymous numbers / Condividi numeri anonimi
share.description: After each finished job, send only its raw estimate, real cost, model family and Quotient version (no dates, no text, no ids) to the shared average. Off: no job is sent; the shared average is still downloaded once a day and used. See PRIVACY.md. / Dopo ogni lavoro manda solo stima, costo vero, famiglia del modello e versione (niente date, testi o codici) alla media condivisa. Spento: nessun lavoro parte; la media condivisa si scarica lo stesso una volta al giorno.
